name: ElectricBorder-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The card sits centred with the full jagged outline visible on both sides.

tagline: A turquoise border crackles with jagged electric arcs.
summary: A content card outlined by a glowing turquoise frame, with a second loose ring of lightning-like lines that shifts and flickers around it.
appearance: A dark rounded card holding a small pill label, a bold white heading and grey body text. Two turquoise outlines wrap it: a smooth blurred glow hugging the edge, and a ragged ring of thin lines that wanders away from the card.
behaviour: The ragged ring keeps redrawing, its peaks surging and drifting around the edge like static electricity at a pace set by speed, while the card and its smooth glow stay still.
demo_content: Badge "Featured" above the heading "Electric Border" and a short paragraph about the outline.
search_phrases: crackling electric border around a card
glowing neon frame for a panel
use_when: A featured card or hero panel needs to feel live and high-energy without a video.
avoid_when: Its outline spills far outside the card and the loop never rests, so it fights tight layouts and busy pages.
customise: Colour, animation speed, noise amount and corner radius are props, with className and style for the wrapper. The glow layers and noise sampling are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A ten-octave noise canvas redraws every frame and several blurred layers sit behind it.

a11y.note: Pure decoration with nothing to operate, but the endless flashing outline ignores reduced-motion preferences.

issues: The jagged outline spills well outside the card and can overlap nearby content.
The crackle never settles, so several of these on one page would compete for attention.
polish_why: Distinctive glow with a believable crackle; the wandering outline is a little untidy at the corners.
title: Electric Border
